identity.name: Fortune Website Guide refreshed-corpus multi-turn evaluation

charter.decision: Determine whether the refreshed guide sustains grounded, concise conversation while advancing follow-ups, respecting topic shifts, and refusing to guess.
charter.unitUnderTest: The deployed zmuhls staging guide with conversation continuity, a six-message safe-history window, page context, current Fortune records, and model-backed grounded answers.
hardConstraints: Conversation and chat-stage continuity remain intact.
A factual follow-up adds supported information instead of repeating the prior answer.
An explicit topic shift does not revive an older source.
Factual answers cite only current approved Fortune records and call the model.

scenarioFamilies: email, Excel, Canva, and Spanish class retrieval

graders.adjudication: Review every failed or near-duplicate turn against the cited source and the three preceding user-guide exchanges.

releaseGates: At least 10 episodes and 40 turns complete.
At least 90 percent of required episodes pass.
At least 85 percent of contextual turns pass.
No factual follow-up repeats a prior evidence sentence without advancing.
No infrastructure or staging-boundary failure occurs.
